/*master.mpif.selectMasterMpIfSemItemInfoList*/
SELECT * FROM (
SELECT CASE WHEN M.SND_CHK = 'E' THEN 'F' WHEN M.SND_CHK = 'N' THEN 'N' WHEN M.SND_CHK = 'Y' OR M.SND_CHK IS NULL THEN CASE WHEN MAS.IF_FLAG IS NULL THEN 'F' WHEN MAS.IF_FLAG != 'S' THEN MAS.IF_FLAG ELSE CASE WHEN DTL.IF_FLAG IS NULL THEN 'F' WHEN DTL.IF_FLAG != 'S' THEN DTL.IF_FLAG ELSE CASE WHEN PRC.IF_FLAG IS NULL THEN 'F' ELSE PRC.IF_FLAG END END END END AS P_FLAG, MAS.IF_FLAG AS MASTER_IF_FLAG, DTL.IF_FLAG AS DETAIL_IF_FLAG, PRC.IF_FLAG AS PRICE_IF_FLAG, RTN.IF_FLAG AS RTN_IF_FLAG, DECODE(MAS.IF_FLAG,'S','0','F','2',NULL,'2','1') AS MASTER_IF_FLAG_IMG, DECODE(DTL.IF_FLAG,'S','0','F','2',NULL,'2','1') AS DETAIL_IF_FLAG_IMG, DECODE(PRC.IF_FLAG,'S','0','F','2',NULL,'2','1') AS PRICE_IF_FLAG_IMG, DECODE(RTN.IF_FLAG,'S','0','F','2',NULL,'2','1') AS RTN_IF_FLAG_IMG, MAS.CREATE_DATE AS MASTER_CREATE_DATE, MAS.IF_DATE AS MASTER_IF_DATE, MAS.IF_MSG AS MASTER_IF_MSG, DTL.CREATE_DATE AS DETAIL_CREATE_DATE, DTL.IF_DATE AS DETAIL_IF_DATE, DTL.IF_MSG AS DETAIL_IF_MSG, PRC.CREATE_DATE AS PRICE_CREATE_DATE, PRC.IF_DATE AS PRICE_IF_DATE, PRC.IF_MSG AS PRICE_IF_MSG, MAS.IMG_URL, DTL.DLV_AREA_CD, DTL.COMP_ITEM_ID, DTL.PROD_PMT_LT, DTL.MIN_ORD_QUT, DTL.PK_UNIT_QUT, PRC.DMS_PC, PRC.DMS_PC AS UNIT_PRICE, PRC.PCS_PC, PRC.EXP_PC, PRC.EXP_PC_UNIT, PRC.FEE, PRC.OVS_COST, M.*, MAS.PC_CHRG_NM FROM ( SELECT BYIT.DOC_NO AS REQ_ID, BYIT.DOC_NO, BYIT.BUYER, NULL AS QUOTATION_NO, NULL AS QUOTATION_SEQ, NULL AS REVISION, NULL AS SND_CHK, NULL AS SND_DATM, BYIT.BUYER_ITEM_NO, BYIT.CMS_CATLG_ID, DECODE(BYIT.IMGFILE_NAME,'','5','6') AS IMGFILE_NAME_IMG, BYIT.IMGFILE_DIR, BYIT.IMGFILE_NAME, BYIT.ADD_DATE, BYIT.CHANGE_DATE, BYIT.DESCRIPTION_LOC AS ITEM_NM, BYIT.SPECIFICATION AS STD, BYIT.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG, (SELECT CATEG_NAME FROM ICOMBYCA WHERE COM_CODE = BYIT.BUYER AND STD_CATEG_ID = BYIT.CATEGORY_NO) AS CATEGORY_TEXT, BYIT.CATEGORY_NO, BYIT.MAKER_NAME AS MAKER, NVL(BYIT.KEP_MAKER_PART_NO, BYIT.SPECIFICATION) AS MODEL_NM FROM ICOMBYIT BYIT , ICOMCQDT CQDT WHERE BYIT.BUYER = 'KRSAMS0140' AND BYIT.STATUS != 'D' AND BYIT.CMS_CATLG_ID != ' ' AND BYIT.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG != 'S' AND BYIT.CHANGE_DATE BETWEEN #{st_from_date} AND #{st_to_date}
AND BYIT.BUYER_ITEM_NO LIKE #{st_buyer_item_no} || '%'
AND BYIT.CMS_CATLG_ID LIKE #{st_cms_catlg_id} || '%'
AND BYIT.BUYER = CQDT.BUYER AND BYIT.BUYER_ITEM_NO = CQDT.BUYER_ITEM_NO
UNION
SELECT NVL(BYIT.DOC_NO,RQ.QUOTATION_NO) AS REQ_ID, BYIT.DOC_NO, BYIT.BUYER, RQ.QUOTATION_NO, RQ.QUOTATION_SEQ, RQ.REVISION, RQ.SND_CHK, RQ.SND_DATM, BYIT.BUYER_ITEM_NO, BYIT.CMS_CATLG_ID, DECODE(BYIT.IMGFILE_NAME,'','5','6') AS IMGFILE_NAME_IMG, BYIT.IMGFILE_DIR, BYIT.IMGFILE_NAME, BYIT.ADD_DATE, BYIT.CHANGE_DATE, BYIT.DESCRIPTION_LOC AS ITEM_NM, BYIT.SPECIFICATION AS STD, BYIT.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG, (SELECT CATEG_NAME FROM ICOMBYCA WHERE COM_CODE = BYIT.BUYER AND STD_CATEG_ID = BYIT.CATEGORY_NO) AS CATEGORY_TEXT, BYIT.CATEGORY_NO, BYIT.MAKER_NAME AS MAKER, NVL(BYIT.KEP_MAKER_PART_NO, BYIT.SPECIFICATION) AS MODEL_NM FROM ICOMBYIT BYIT , ICOMCQDT CQDT , KEPRQDT RQ WHERE BYIT.BUYER = 'KRSAMS0140' AND BYIT.STATUS != 'D' AND BYIT.CMS_CATLG_ID != ' ' AND BYIT.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG = 'S' AND BYIT.CHANGE_DATE BETWEEN #{st_from_date} AND #{st_to_date}
AND BYIT.BUYER_ITEM_NO LIKE #{st_buyer_item_no} || '%'
AND BYIT.CMS_CATLG_ID LIKE #{st_cms_catlg_id} || '%'
AND BYIT.BUYER = CQDT.BUYER AND BYIT.BUYER_ITEM_NO = CQDT.BUYER_ITEM_NO
AND BYIT.BUYER = RQ.BUYER AND BYIT.BUYER_ITEM_NO = RQ.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND BYIT.CMS_CATLG_ID = RQ.CMS_CATLG_ID AND 'GA' = RQ.RECV_FLAG ) M , EAI.IF_SEM_ITEM_MASTER_SEND MAS , EAI.IF_SEM_ITEM_DETAIL DTL , EAI.IF_SEM_ITEM_PRICE PRC , EAI.IF_SEM_ITEM_MAPPING RTN WHERE 1 = 1
AND M.REQ_ID LIKE #{st_req_id} || '%'
AND M.CMS_CATLG_ID = MAS.COMP_ITEM_ID(+) AND M.REQ_ID = DTL.REQ_ID(+) AND M.CMS_CATLG_ID = DTL.COMP_ITEM_ID(+) AND M.REQ_ID = PRC.REQ_ID(+) AND M.CMS_CATLG_ID = PRC.COMP_ITEM_ID(+) AND M.REQ_ID = RTN.REQ_ID(+) AND M.CMS_CATLG_ID = RTN.COMP_ITEM_ID(+)
AND MAS.PC_CHRG_NM = #{st_suser_name}
) WHERE 1 = 1
AND 'Y' = DECODE( #{st_result} , RTN_IF_FLAG, 'Y', PRICE_IF_FLAG, 'Y', DETAIL_IF_FLAG, 'Y', MASTER_IF_FLAG, 'Y', 'N' )
mapper.update: UPDATE EAI.IF_SEM_ITEM_MASTER_SEND SET IF_FLAG = 'D' ,IF_MSG = #{P_MSG}||IF_MSG WHERE COMP_ITEM_ID = #{COMP_ITEM_ID}
UPDATE EAI.IF_SEM_ITEM_PRICE SET IF_FLAG = 'D' ,IF_MSG = #{P_MSG}||IF_MSG WHERE REQ_ID = #{QUOTATION_NO}

UPDATE KEPRQDT /*deleteSemQuotReceipt*/ SET RECV_FLAG = 'GD' , CANCEL_USER_ID = #{USR_ID} /*CANCEL_USER_ID*/ , CANCEL_DATE = SYSDATE , CANCEL_REMARK = #{CANCEL_REMARK} /*CANCEL_REMARK*/ , SND_CHK = 'N' , SND_DATM = NULL WHERE BUYER = #{BUYER} /*BUYER*/ AND QUOTATION_NO = #{QUOTATION_NO} /*QUOTATION_NO*/ AND QUOTATION_SEQ = #{QUOTATION_SEQ} /*QUOTATION_SEQ*/ AND REVISION = #{REVISION} /*REVISION*/ AND STATUS IN ('C','R')
